answer:
As a student you can see only your own records, so this answer covers your own record only; other students' records need staff access.

sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, f.academic_year, f.component, f.amount_due, f.amount_paid, (f.amount_due - f.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, f.due_date, f.paid_on, f.status FROM (SELECT * FROM students WHERE student_id = 'S2026CS012') AS s JOIN (SELECT * FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = 'S2026CS012') AS f ON s.student_id = f.student_id ORDER BY s.student_id, f.due_date LIMIT 50
